outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each marker is an individual sample measurement (n=141); scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points.
Scatter plot of noise vs. circadian component (mean ± s.d. per reporter) with error bars; scatter-type plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement per the check guidelines.
Density/line plots of fitted normal distributions of periods and amplitudes; line plots are exempt since overlaying individual points would be unreadable.
Box plots already show distribution and additionally have individual data points overlaid as dots for each sample.
Polar histograms display the distribution of phase differences across bins (analogous to a histogram/distribution plot), which are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Polar histogram of averaged phase differences by subtype; histogram-type distribution plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line plot illustrating an example signal and fitted curve for methodological demonstration; line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Scatter plot with error bars where each marker represents an individual sample (n=117); scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points overlay requirement.
